headline: Bring nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices into Home Assistant
intro: Use the Bluetooth integration to discover nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices and make them available to compatible Home Assistant integrations. Bluetooth Classic devices are not supported. Linux installations need a working BlueZ and D-Bus setup, and Home Assistant Container also needs the required socket access and capabilities for full adapter management.
highlights: Discover compatible BLE devices nearby for supported integrations
Configure adapter scanning as Auto, Active, or Passive when supported
Meet Linux requirements for BlueZ, D-Bus, and container permissions
